contactId.title: Contact Id
contactId.description: Contact id used to upsert context.

hasIssue.title: Has Issue
hasIssue.description: True if the user still has an unresolved issue at session end.

newGoal.title: New Goal
newGoal.description: Unfinished user goal to continue later, or empty string if none.

newStyle.title: New Style
newStyle.description: Communication preference inferred from this session (e.g. concise, detailed, formal).

newSummary.title: New Summary
newSummary.description: Detailed 4-5 sentence summary combining last session summary (when available) with this session: user inputs, assistant recommendations, actions taken, and outcomes.
